name: Whisper (local)
description: Runs Whisper on your machine with faster-whisper. No API key; the model downloads on first use. Transcribes each utterance once the VAD marks it finished. Install with: uv sync --extra whisper

model.title: Model
model.description: A Whisper size or a Hugging Face CTranslate2 model id. Bigger is more accurate and slower.

compute_type.title: Compute type
compute_type.description: Weight precision. int8 is fastest on CPU.

no_speech_prob.title: No-speech threshold
no_speech_prob.description: Segments more likely than this to be non-speech are dropped.
